decisions.reason: As a high-resolution piezo inkjet printer close to our core marking technologies, it fits our existing knowledge base and in-house R&D capabilities, so early market presence justifies continued learning and refinement.

This software module directly supports digital inline variable-data printing and traceability, aligns with our strategic move toward digitalization and serialization, and can be improved efficiently using our established system and application know-how.

An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends our established coding expertise into a valuable adjacent application where our ink, integration and service capabilities give us strong absorptive capacity to improve and commercialize it.
